name: feedback-popover

frames.best_why: Expanded form is fully open with a chosen mood, typed comment and visible Submit button.

tagline: Ask for a quick mood rating, then unfold a comment box and thank-you.
summary: A small dark pill asks 'Like our service?' with four mood faces. Picking one expands it into a comment box with Submit, then flashes a check and a thank-you message.
appearance: A narrow dark rounded pill holding the question and four tiny face icons. After a mood is chosen it grows into a taller dark card with a bordered text area at the top, a white Submit button at the bottom right, and later a blue check circle.
behaviour: Clicking a face expands the pill into a form with a smooth height animation and turns that icon blue. Submit swaps the button for a spinner, then the card shows a check and two short thank-you lines before resetting.
demo_content: Question 'Like our service?', placeholder 'Your app is awesoooome', comment 'Checkout felt really fast today!'.
search_phrases: small feedback form with emoji faces
quick mood rating with comment box
feedback form that says thank you
use_when: You want a lightweight inline way to collect a rating and one comment without opening a full form.
avoid_when: Feedback needs several fields or real validation; this is one comment box with a mock submit.
customise: The question, mood icons and placeholder are written in the source, and Submit runs a fake one-second delay. Colours and the expanded size come from classes you would edit.
weight_why: A few nodes with small layout and opacity animations; the request is only a one-second timer.

a11y.note: The icon-only mood buttons have no accessible names, and nothing announces the opened form or success.

issues: The comment box relies on placeholder text only, so it has no persistent label.
Submit is a fake one-second timer, so feedback never actually leaves the page.
polish_why: Clean expansion and a complete mood-to-thank-you flow; placeholder-only field and mock submit.
title: Feedback Popover
